name: F2
requested_by: owner (chat, 2026-10-26: "can we continue than", answering whether to add the best S5 settings to the forward test)
source: results/S5/report.md: none of the 160 settings was profitable on 2019-2022; these three came closest or were picked by the training data. No candle on or after the forward start was read for these settings before this file was committed.
rules: gse_research/setups.py at this commit: 1D + 4H GSE bias both agreeing as the trend, GSE v4.1 levels (lookback 10), first touch with a resting limit at the level, stop K ATR from the entry, target X times the risk
costs: OANDA bid/ask candles, 0.10 slippage on stops and market exits, conservative intrabar order, one position at a time per setting

criteria.running: fewer than 100 closed trades for the setting
criteria.pass: net expectancy > 0, profit factor >= 1.2 and 90% weekly-block bootstrap lower bound > 0
criteria.weak: positive but short of a pass criterion

note: At S5's rates (about 25-30 trades a year for A, 12-17 for B) a verdict takes roughly 3-8 years. Interim reports are tallies, not evidence; nothing here should be traded with real money before a pass.
